set_base_tariff.name: Set normal rate plan
set_base_tariff.description: Store your normal day-to-day rate plan (what we called BAU) and, by default, push it. This is what the Powerwall returns to whenever no event is active.

device_id.name: Energy site
device_id.description: The Tesla Fleet Powerwall / energy site device.

rates.name: Rates
rates.description: List of {start, label, buy, sell}. Each applies from its start until the next, wrapping midnight. Labels: Super Off-Peak, Off-Peak, Mid-Peak or Peak. Price per kWh including tax. Each row becomes its own row in the Tesla app.

tariff.name: Raw tariff
tariff.description: A full Tesla tariff_content_v2 object, used instead of rates (advanced).

name.name: Plan name
name.description: Shown in the Tesla app as 'name (Normal)', 'name (Power Down)' and so on.

utility.name: Utility provider
utility.description: Shown as the utility provider in the Tesla app, e.g. Octopus Energy. Defaults to Home Assistant.

daily_charge.name: Standing charge
daily_charge.description: Per day, in the plan's currency.

push.name: Push now
push.description: Send to the Powerwall now (combined with any active events).

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return the plan without storing or sending it.

capture_base_tariff.name: Capture normal rate plan from Tesla
capture_base_tariff.description: Read the rate plan currently set in the Tesla app and store it as your normal plan. Does not push.

device_id.name: Energy site
device_id.description: The Tesla Fleet Powerwall / energy site device.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return what was read without storing it.

sync_events.name: Sync events
sync_events.description: Make the stored events from one source match a list - from an entity attribute (e.g. the Octopus Energy integration's joined sessions) or given directly (e.g. from a calendar). New events are added, removed ones dropped, past ones ignored. Tesla is only called if the resulting plan changes.

device_id.name: Energy site
device_id.description: The Tesla Fleet Powerwall / energy site device.

entity_id.name: Source entity
entity_id.description: Entity with a list attribute of sessions (each with start and end), e.g. event.octopus_energy_<account>_octoplus_power_down_events.

events.name: Events
events.description: Alternatively, a list of {start, end, id} - e.g. built from calendar.get_events.

attribute.name: Attribute
attribute.description: List attribute on the source entity. Defaults to joined_events if present, otherwise events.

source.name: Source name
source.description: Groups these events; other sources are left alone. Defaults to the entity ID.

label.name: Use normal-plan label
label.description: Give the window one of your normal plan's labels (Super Off-Peak, Off-Peak, Mid-Peak or Peak), so it takes that label's prices and Tesla app colour. Use instead of prices. E.g. Peak for an export session, Super Off-Peak for a cheap/free session.

activate.name: When to apply
activate.description: event_day (default): put the event into the plan at 00:00 on its own day, or straight away if that's today. now: as soon as it's known.

relabel.name: Relabel on the event's day
relabel.description: Map of normal-plan label to label for the rest of the event's day, e.g. {"Peak": "Mid-Peak"} so the event is the only Peak window that day.

pre_label.name: Drain beforehand with label
pre_label.description: Label (e.g. Peak) applied immediately before each block of events for the same length of time, so the battery exports first - e.g. before a free-electricity session. Never overlaps an earlier event.

pre_minutes.name: Drain length
pre_minutes.description: Fixed drain length in minutes instead of matching each block's length.

buy_price.name: Import price
buy_price.description: Custom price per kWh for the window instead of a label. Needs a label your normal plan doesn't use, so a new colour may appear in the Tesla app.

sell_price.name: Export price
sell_price.description: Defaults to the import price. Must not exceed it.

name.name: Event name
name.description: Shown in notifications and the Tesla plan name, e.g. Power Down.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return the resulting plan without storing or sending anything.

add_event.name: Add event
add_event.description: Add (or update, by ID) a single window, e.g. a test or a manual override.
